result.summary: The image depicts an urban intersection with mixed-use buildings, featuring basic pedestrian infrastructure such as sidewalks and marked continental crosswalks. However, the environment is compromised by poor pavement quality, sidewalk obstructions like trash bags and utility poles, and a lack of modern safety enhancements like curb extensions.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: Trash bags and a large utility pole on the left sidewalk significantly narrow the accessible path for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: The asphalt within the crosswalk area is cracked and uneven, creating potential trip hazards.

hazards.name: Visual Clutter
hazards.description: Dense overhead wiring and multiple utility poles create a cluttered visual environment that can distract road users.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the intersection corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pavement Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair the cracked roadway and refresh the high-visibility crosswalk markings to ensure a smooth and clear crossing path.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Management
interventions.description: Implement designated waste collection areas and consolidate utility poles to clear the pedestrian right-of-way.
